# Shuttle Brief
"A moderately sized mercenary ship, featuring a robotics lab and a peculiar hole in the middle."
[italic]Crafted by crafty Vox, shipped by Vox Shipyards.[/italic]
# GETTING THE MOST OUT OF THE TAURID
- The Taurid is a non-expedition mercenary ship, intended for in-sector assaults and looting of enemy bluespace structures. Assemble a crew to clear out those environments quickly. - Featuring its own dedicated robotics lab, it's especially equipped for creating and hiring Cyborgs as crew. and Cyborgs don't need medicine! - Utilize the free space in the cargo bay for installation of additional machines, and get creative with adding additional conveyer belts.
